attchmntText: HALEOS LABS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary:
Haleos Labs Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in Business Standard and Telugu Prabha on November 12, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 11, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net loss after tax of 954.41 lakhs, compared to a loss of 357.12 lakhs in the same period last year. Earnings per share were negative 30.01. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net profit after tax of 843.16 lakhs, compared to a loss of 357.12 lakhs in the previous year. Earnings per share were positive 36.55. Statutory auditors conducted a limited review of these results.

Sri Sarvaraya Sugars Limited also approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting on November 10, 2026.

Quadrant Future Tek Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the same periods on November 10, 2026.

Metal Closures Private Limited, in liquidation, issued an e-auction sale notice for land and building in Bangalore. The reserve price is 90.00 crores. The e-auction is scheduled for November 27, 2026, from 10.00 AM to 11.00 AM.

attchmntText: HALEOS LABS LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Haleos Labs Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board granted in-principle approval for a strategic alliance with HRV Global Life Sciences Private Limited for research, manufacturing, and commercialization. This transaction is subject to definitive agreements and customary approvals. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 15,603.35 lakhs. Net profit stood at 754.92 lakhs. Earnings per share were 24.97. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 8,820.38 lakhs. Net profit was 431.14 lakhs. Earnings per share were 14.26. The statutory auditors issued unmodified opinions on the limited review.
